Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.v1.generated.model

Record Class ClientRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.v1.generated.model.ClientRequest
Record Components:
clientId - Public identifier of the client; it must contain a non-blank character.
name - Human readable name; it must contain a non-blank character.
confidential - Whether the client can keep a secret. Defaults to false.
authMethods - Client authentication methods, for example client_secret_basic or none.
grantTypes - Allowed grant types, for example authorization_code or refresh_token.
redirectUris - Allowed redirect URIs.
scopes - Allowed scopes.
requireProofKey - Whether PKCE is required. Defaults to false.
audiences - Audiences of the issued access tokens; absent or empty means the client identifier.
accessTokenTtl - Lifetime of the access tokens, as an ISO-8601 duration such as PT5M.
refreshTokenTtl - Lifetime of the refresh tokens, as an ISO-8601 duration such as PT1H.
accessTokenFormat - Format of the access tokens, self-contained (a signed JWT) or reference (an opaque token resolved by introspection); absent or blank means self-contained.
reuseRefreshTokens - Whether refresh tokens are reused instead of rotated. Defaults to false.
postLogoutRedirectUris - URIs the user may be redirected to after an OpenID Connect RP-initiated logout; a post_logout_redirect_uri that is not listed is never honoured. Absent means none.
requireConsent - Whether the end-user must explicitly grant the requested scopes on a consent page. Defaults to false.
mfaRequired - Whether every user who signs in through this client must complete a second factor, whatever their account setting. Defaults to false.
